text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — we saw a sharp tail-latency increase on eu-west yesterday around 17:10 UTC, cluster GPUs were saturated and requests queued up.
AJ Rao: saw that. CPU for control-plane spiked too? any network spikes?
Kevin Li: network looked fine, but the per-route queue lengths hit limits. Some low-priority batch routes flooded the queue and starved chat routes.
Sophie Chan: can we throttle by route? current admission control is global FIFO with token-bucket per instance.
AJ Rao: global FIFO is simple but means noisy neighbors cause head-of-line blocking.
Maria Gomez: proposal: introduce two-tier queueing — per-route small FIFO + global priority queue for latency-sensitive routes. Low-priority routes get rate-limited when global GPU util > 80%.
Kevin Li: sounds reasonable. We should also allow burst credits for paid-dedicated customers (reserved capacity) so they can burst without evicting shared traffic.
Sophie Chan: what about cost/regional constraints? eu-west has lower capacity; policy should be region-aware.
AJ Rao: config sketch:

```
admission_control:
  mode: mixed
  per_route_queue: true
  priority_classes:
    - name: latency
      routes: ["/chat", "/tooling*"]
      weight: high
    - name: batch
      weight: low
  gpu_threshold_pct: 80
  reserved_burst: {tier: dedicated, credits: 2000}
```

Maria Gomez: We also need metrics to avoid oscillation: track queue-serve-rate, eviction_count, avg_latency by route, and GPU_hot_seconds.
ops-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-348 — gpu-saturation-eu-west tagged by Maria Gomez
Kevin Li: for implementation, start with soft limits (reject 429 with Retry-After) for batch when util>80%, then promote to hard admission if continutes 10m.
Sophie Chan: user-facing behavior: return structured error with reason "capacity" and hints: "try dedicated or reduce concurrency". Also emit billing tag if reserved burst used.
AJ Rao: risk: adding many per-route queues increases memory/cpu on frontends. We should cap number of active per-route queues and fallback to class-based pooling.
Maria Gomez: agree — cap 250 queues per proxy, LRU eviction of least-recently-used route-level queues.
Kevin Li: timeline? can we test in staging with load-gen across region simulating 1.5x normal traffic?
Sophie Chan: I'll schedule a canary next Wed. I'll add a test harness and a dashboard with per-route queue heatmap.
Maria Gomez: assign owners: AJ will spec config, Kevin will prototype in runtime, Sophie will own tests/canary. I'll draft runbook for ops.
AJ Rao: ping @Sophie Chan when spec PR is up. :thumbsup:
Sophie Chan: noted. linking docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queueing (WIP)
ops-bot: deploy queued: admission-control/mixed-mode v0.1 -> staging
Kevin Li: one more: we should ensure graceful fallback to smaller models when admission triggers to preserve user experience.
Maria Gomez: good—add model-fallback policy as part of rollout.
Sophie Chan: ok closing for now, will post results from canary in this thread.
